#!/usr/bin/python
import os
import signal
import time

base = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
log_path = os.path.join(base, 'audit.log')
reopen_requested = False
terminate_requested = False


def request_reopen(signum, frame):
    global reopen_requested
    reopen_requested = True


def request_termination(signum, frame):
    global terminate_requested
    terminate_requested = True


signal.signal(signal.SIGHUP, request_reopen)
signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, request_termination)

log = open(log_path, 'a')
try:
    while not terminate_requested:
        if reopen_requested:
            reopen_requested = False
            log.close()
            log = open(log_path, 'a')

        log.write('audit heartbeat\n')
        log.flush()
        time.sleep(1)
finally:
    log.close()
ANTRIEB_WRITER_EOF

' 'process_exit=clean'; grep -H -F 'Previously archived audit event A100.' archive/previous.log; grep -H -F 'Current audit event A101.' archive/audit-pre-hup.log; sha256sum writer.py archive/previous.log archive/audit-pre-hup.log; sudo -n rm -f /run/writer-postrestart.pid /tmp/writer-postrestart.out
